intro: Chulalongkorn Hospital is a large public hospital and teaching school on Rama IV Road in Pathumwan, so outpatients and visiting families pack the area every day, and the recurring question is simply where to stay for an easy round trip to the wards. The upside of this district is that it's wrapped by Silom, Sathorn and Sam Yan, with options from clean budget hostels to 5-star towers facing Lumphini Park — and you can walk in from BTS Sala Daeng or MRT Si Lom via skywalk. Below we list only places you can genuinely walk to or reach in a short drive, ordered cheapest to priciest, each with its real distance to the hospital so the call is easy.

blocks.html: Short answer: Chulalongkorn Hospital sits on Rama IV Road facing Lumphini Park, across from the BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Si Lom interchange, and both stations have a skywalk that leads straight into the hospital. For an easy walk, pick a hotel at the head of Silom or on Rama IV — Crowne Plaza Lumpini Park is the closest of the 5-stars at about a 5-minute walk, while budget picks Pula Silom and BnB98 on Silom Soi 2 are roughly 8–10 minutes on foot. On the Sam Yan side, the Mandarin (right by Sam Yan MRT) is a short-drive option.

blocks.text: Hotels near Chulalongkorn Hospital, by distance & budget

items.name: Pula Silom (D Varee Xpress)
items.meta: 📍 8-min walk (650 m) to Chulalongkorn Hospital · ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · close to BTS Sala Daeng · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small 49-room budget hotel tucked into Silom Soi 2, just off the BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Si Lom interchange, then about an 8-minute walk along Rama IV to the hospital. Rooms have a fridge, safe and kettle, and reviews mostly praise the location and staff. Worth knowing: there's a bar next door, so you may hear some music at night. A good fit for check-up visitors keeping costs down who don't mind a slightly longer walk.

items.name: BnB98 Silom Hotel
items.meta: 📍 10-min walk (750 m) to Chulalongkorn Hospital · ★ 3-star · Best for: Patient families · by BTS Sala Daeng · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small hotel on Silom Soi 2/1, almost on top of BTS Sala Daeng — step out of the soi and it's about a 10-minute walk along Rama IV to the hospital. There's a 24-hour front desk, an ATM and parking, and the price is very friendly. Cleanliness reviews are mixed by room, so it's worth checking recent ones before you book. A solid choice for families keeping vigil over several nights without paying a premium.

items.name: Mandarin Hotel Managed by Centre Point
items.meta: 📍 6-min drive (1.3 km) · by Sam Yan MRT to Chulalongkorn Hospital · ★ 4-star · Best for: Sam Yan side · MRT access · plenty of rooms · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A large hotel at 662 Rama IV Road, right by Sam Yan MRT (under a minute's walk) — same road as the hospital but a different stretch, about a 6-minute drive, or ride one MRT stop from Sam Yan to Si Lom and take the skywalk in. It has many room types, a pool and a gym, and sits next to Samyan Mitrtown for easy meals. A good base if you prefer the Sam Yan side and want to travel mainly by train.

items.name: Triple Two Silom
items.meta: 📍 6-min drive (1.2 km) or 15-min walk to Chulalongkorn Hospital · ★ 4-star · Best for: Quiet boutique · high reviews · Surawong–Sam Yan · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 75-room boutique hotel on the Surawong stretch of Silom, toward the Sam Yan side, with very high review scores (around 9 out of 10) for cleanliness and staff, plus a pool, gym and free breakfast. It's about 1 km from Sam Yan MRT, roughly a 6-minute drive to the hospital or a 15-minute walk along the road. A good match if you're here for a check-up and want a quiet, comfortable room that's still good value.

items.name: Montien Hotel Surawong Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 5-min drive (1.1 km) · 5-min walk to BTS Sala Daeng to Chulalongkorn Hospital · ★ 5-star · Best for: Newly renovated 5-star · central Silom · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A renovated 475-room heritage 5-star on Surawong Road with a spa, outdoor pool and restaurant. It's about a 5-minute walk to BTS Sala Daeng, where the skywalk leads into the hospital, or a 5-minute drive door to door. Sitting between Sala Daeng and Sam Yan, it has a central Silom location with food around the clock. A good pick if you want full 5-star service while staying close to the hospital.

items.name: Crowne Plaza Bangkok Lumpini Park by IHG
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (400 m) to Chulalongkorn Hospital · ★ 5-star · Best for: Closest 5-star to the hospital · families · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 387-room 5-star at 952 Rama IV Road — the closest 5-star to the hospital, about a 5-minute walk, and only roughly 3 minutes from BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Si Lom. It has a pool, spa, gym and a club lounge, and backs onto Lumphini Park for a calming stroll. The best option if you're travelling as a family and want full service and a comfortable room after a long hospital day while still being able to walk to and from.

items.name: Dusit Thani Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 7-min walk (600 m) to Chulalongkorn Hospital · ★ 5-star · Best for: Luxury by Lumphini · park-view rooms · full service · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A legendary luxury hotel rebuilt from the ground up and reopened in 2024, at 98 Rama IV Road across from Lumphini Park and connected directly to the BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Si Lom interchange. Every room looks over the park, with a spa, pool and several restaurants, and the hospital is about a 7-minute walk. It's the priciest on this list — the choice for anyone who wants top-tier luxury during treatment and isn't watching the budget.

faq.q: Which hotel is the closest walk to Chulalongkorn Hospital?
faq.a: Among the 5-stars, Crowne Plaza Lumpini Park is the closest, on Rama IV about a 5-minute walk (400 m), followed by Dusit Thani (about 7 minutes). For budget, Pula Silom and BnB98 on Silom Soi 2 are roughly 8–10 minutes on foot. All sit on the hospital's side and near BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Si Lom.

faq.q: By train, which entrance do I use for Chulalongkorn Hospital?
faq.a: The easiest is BTS Sala Daeng, Exit 5, then follow the skywalk straight into the hospital; or MRT Si Lom, Exit 2, which has a connecting skywalk too. Both stations are across Rama IV on the Lumphini Park side, so you don't cross the big road. From the Sam Yan side (say, staying at the Mandarin), ride one MRT stop to Si Lom and take the skywalk.

faq.q: What's the easiest way from the airport to Chulalongkorn Hospital?
faq.a: From Suvarnabhumi, take the Airport Rail Link to Phaya Thai, change to the BTS and get off at Sala Daeng, then use the skywalk into the hospital; or a direct taxi is about 40–60 minutes depending on traffic. From Don Mueang, a taxi is simpler at about 45–60 minutes. If you're with a patient who has limited mobility or lots of luggage, a taxi or Grab straight to your hotel is the most comfortable.
